    assembly_hash = sha(ROOT/'tests/KatLang.Tests/bin/Debug/net11.0/KatLang.Tests.dll')
    assert source_hash == execution['source_state_sha256']
    assert assembly_hash == execution['core_assembly_sha256'] == plans['assembly_sha256']
    audits = {}
    for mode in ['ordinary', 'forced']:
        coverage = collections.Counter()
        elapsed = []
        rss = []
        records = []
        assert len(execution[mode]) == len(plans['plans']) == 44
        for item, plan in zip(execution[mode], plans['plans']):
            label = 'main-'+mode+'-'+plan['label']
            assert item['label'] == label and item['passed']
            receipt = read(OUT/(label+'.json'))
            assert receipt['exit'] == 0 and receipt['unchanged']
            assert receipt['mode'] == mode and receipt['cwd'] == str(ROOT)
            assert receipt['command'] == s.test_command('KatLang.Tests', label, (OUT/'batches'/(plan['label']+'-filter.txt')).read_text())
            env = receipt['environment']
            assert not any(k.upper().startswith('KATLANG_REGENERATE_') for k in env)
            assert env.get('KATLANG_FORCE_INVOCATION_PLANS') == ('1' if mode == 'forced' else None)
            supervisor = read(OUT/(label+'-supervisor.json'))
            assert supervisor == receipt['supervisor']
            assert supervisor['exit'] == 0 and supervisor['stop'] is None and supervisor['counts']['fail_lines'] == 0
            assert supervisor['elapsed_seconds'] <= 900
            rows = read(OUT/'batches'/(plan['label']+'-expected.json'))
            audit, got = s.parse_trx(OUT/(label+'.trx'), rows)
            assert audit['completed'] and audit['all_passed'] and audit['exact_identities']
            assert not (coverage.keys() & got.keys())
            coverage.update(got)
            previous = read(OUT/(label+'-audit.json'))
            assert previous['audit'] == audit and previous['source_state_sha256'] == source_hash and previous['core_assembly_sha256'] == assembly_hash
            assert previous['passed'] and previous['unchanged']
            log = (OUT/(label+'.log')).read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')
            assert not any(x in log for x in ['[FAIL]', 'Failed!', '[SKIP]', '[ERROR]', 'Unhandled exception', 'Build FAILED', 'RESOURCE_STOP'])
            elapsed.append(supervisor['elapsed_seconds'])
            rss.extend(h['rss'] for sample in supervisor['samples'] for h in sample['hosts'])
            records.append(dict(label=label, cases=audit['executed'], trx_sha256=audit['sha256']))
        assert coverage == want and len(coverage) == sum(coverage.values()) == 42333
        audits[mode] = dict(core=42333, cli=502, public_api=151, total=42986, core_batches=44,
            failed=0, skipped=0, missing=0, extra=0, duplicates=0, aborted=0,
            exact_identities=True, elapsed_core_commands_seconds=sum(elapsed), max_batch_seconds=max(elapsed),
            max_sampled_testhost_rss_bytes=max(rss, default=0), records=records)

    phases = read(OUT/'canonical-phases.json')
    supplementary = read(OUT/'canonical-cli-api-audit.json')
    for mode in ['ordinary', 'forced']:
        for project, prior in supplementary[mode].items():
            audit, got = s.parse_trx(Path(prior['trx']), read(OUT/(project+'-inventory')/'expected.json'))
            assert prior == audit and audit['completed'] and audit['all_passed'] and audit['exact_identities']
    # Snapshot canonical evidence in this directory so the report is independently reviewable.
    copied = []
    for label, receipt in phases.items():
        assert receipt['unchanged']
        if label == 'canonical-lean':
            assert receipt['exit'] == 0 and receipt['supervisor']['stop'] is None
        else:
            assert receipt['supervisor']['stop']['reason'] == 'validation exceeded 15 minutes'
            assert receipt['supervisor']['counts']['fail_lines'] == 0
            assert 'Build succeeded' in (OUT/(label+'.log')).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        for directory in receipt['validation_directories']:
            src = Path(directory)
            dest = OUT/'canonical-evidence'/label/src.name
            assert not dest.exists()
            shutil.copytree(src, dest)
            copied.append(dict(original=str(src), snapshot=str(dest)))
    targets = read(OUT/'lean-targets.json')
    assert {r['target'] for r in targets} == {'CoreTests','KatLangArityLaws','AstDemo','CoreArityAlgebra','CoreArityAlgebraProofs','SemanticExplorerCases','LanguageSpecCases'}
    assert all(r['exit'] == 0 for r in targets)
    build = read(OUT/'post-warning-fix-build.json')
    assert build['exit'] == 0 and build['unchanged'] and build['supervisor']['stop'] is None
    buildlog = (OUT/'post-warning-fix-build.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    assert 'Build succeeded' in buildlog and re.search(r'0 Warning\(s\)', buildlog) and re.search(r'0 Error\(s\)', buildlog)
    equivalent = read(OUT/'warning-fix-executable-equivalence.json')
    assert equivalent['passed'] and equivalent['canonical_timeout_execution_inputs_unchanged'] and equivalent['build_warnings'] == 0
    # The only unstaged source change is the two nullability annotations made for the build warnings.
    assert git('diff','--name-only').decode().splitlines() == ['tests/KatLang.Tests/CompletedStaticStructureTests.cs']
    for args in [('diff','--check'), ('diff','--cached','--check')]:
        subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(ROOT),*args],env=v.env('ordinary'),check=True,capture_output=True)
    (OUT/'warning-fix-unstaged.patch').write_bytes(git('diff','--binary'))
    (OUT/'final-status.txt').write_bytes(git('status','--short','--untracked-files=all'))
    (OUT/'final-staged-name-status.txt').write_bytes(git('diff','--cached','--name-status'))
    before = read(OUT/'before.json')
    final = dict(main=v.baseline(),main_metadata=v.t.metadata(ROOT),preserved=guard,
        integration=v.t.state(v.INTEGRATION,True),integration_metadata=v.t.metadata(v.INTEGRATION),
        candidate=v.t.state(v.CAND,True),candidate_metadata=v.t.metadata(v.CAND))
    assert final['main_metadata'] == before['main_metadata']
    assert final['main']['head'] == '6a16bd31459f9086ac584e6687c911e6e50acf86'
    dump('after.json', final)
    dump('final-coverage-audit.json', dict(status='PASS under the scoped owner-approved exhaustive 44-batch V3 fallback',
        completed_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),modes=audits,lean=targets,build_warnings=0,
        canonical_whole_core='INCOMPLETE in both modes: 900-second timeout, zero observed failures, no final core TRX; not counted as PASS',
        limitation='Whole collections and every exact case are covered; cross-class co-residency across separate batches is unproven.',
        protected_state=guard,canonical_evidence_snapshots=copied,
        original_user_index_sha256=before['main_metadata']['index']['sha256'],final_index_sha256=final['main_metadata']['index']['sha256']))
    s.frozen()
    print('FINAL AUDIT PASS: 42986 exact .NET cases per mode; 7 Lean targets; build zero warnings; original index and protected worktrees preserved.',flush=True)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
